en-US.title: Yureka
en-US.subtitle: Goldback, offers, gift cards
en-US.description:
Yureka is your Wealth OS — Goldback rewards, partner offers, and gift cards in a native app.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See your live Goldback balance and activity
• Browse marketplace and Goldback offers
• Buy gift cards with custom amounts and redeem at partner sites
• Sign in with Apple, Google, or email

Payments for gift cards use Razorpay checkout. Support: support@yureka.one
en-US.releaseNotes: First release: native Home, Offers, and Gift cards, plus the live Yureka dashboard.

review.notes: Sign in with the review account provided in App Store Connect. Gift-card checkout uses Razorpay, not Apple IAP. Expenses/Gmail stay in the in-app web dashboard. Contact support@yureka.one.
